'''Nastuonodon''' was an ancient (c. [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]]) [[Sultan/Legends|sultan]] on the planet [[Mourn]] who was responsible for commissioning the construction of "[[Electric Caliph]]s". Thousands of years after Nastuonodon died, the Electric Caliphs lay in wait, unused for millennia. Unable to defeat or to come into negotiation with the [[Gargantelle]]s of the neighboring planet [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] hired a team of [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanese]] lawyers to persuade the sultan's droids to wage war and destroy the Gargantelles. Having accomplished their work, the Electric Caliphs then immolated themselves by igniting Mourn's crust.
